title: Restriction.
officialText:
Each elevator agency director shall supervise and perform elevator work or inspections and tests pursuant to article 304 of chapter 3 of this code for only one (1) elevator agency, and shall not inspect and/or test elevators or perform elevator work on related devices as an inspector, director or elevator agency helper for any other elevator agency.

(Am. 2019 N.Y. Laws Ch. 750, 1/1/2020, eff. 1/1/2022; Am. 2020 N.Y. Laws Ch. 55, 4/3/2020, eff. 1/1/2022; Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 1/1/2022)
